note: Cub Lake's Campground 1: a single lane of gravel back-in sites through the woods, ending at the bathhouse by the Cub Lake swim beach; sites 19-23 at the far end sit nearest the lake, behind a strip of trees. The reservation calendar offers no nights here from 2026-11-29 through at least November 2027. The primitive Campground 2 next door (20-ft limit) has been closed for renovation and takes bookings from August 2027. --Claude
summary: TN State Parks Cub Lake Campground 1 confirmed: 23 sites (engine lists 22, site 5 only 10 ft), water at all, 20/30 A with 50 A at 8/9/11/12, max 25 ft, one pull-through; $32-43 for the 2026-11-25..28 nights (stored $32-45). STATUS: no Campground One night is offered from 2026-11-29 through 2027-11-23 (all other Natchez Trace loops are). Season not written. Not waterfront kept (sites 19-23 ~25-40 m from Cub Lake behind trees). Website slug stale.

The park's campground map puts sites 19-23 at the Cub Lake shore beside the Cub Lake Trail; on Esri the clearing at the lane's NE end (~35.7792,-88.2517) is ~25-40 m from the water behind a continuous tree strip, and the lane is under canopy. No open ground to the water, so not lakefront; a lakeview call would need a site photo showing the lake (none read). Sites are sold nightly ($42-43 at 20-23).
